```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import make_column_selector, ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.compose import make_column_selector as selector
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, plot_tree
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.svm import SVC
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix
import warnings
df = pd.read_csv("CAH-201803-train.csv")
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
df_test = pd.read_csv("CAH-201803-test.csv")
df.info()
```

```{python}

df["Party"] = df["political_affiliation"].map({
    "Republican": 0,
    "Democrat": 1,
    "Independent": 2
})

X = df.drop(['Party', 'political_affiliation'], axis=1)
y = df["Party"]
```

```{python}
num = selector(dtype_include=['number'])
cat = selector(dtype_include=['object'])
ct = ColumnTransformer(
 [
    ('num', StandardScaler(), num),            
    ('cat', OneHotEncoder(drop='first', handle_unknown='ignore'), cat)  
], remainder='passthrough')

log_pipe = Pipeline([
('preprocessing', ct),    
("log", LogisticRegression())
])

param_grid_log = {"log__C": [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10], 
"log__solver": ["saga"], "log__penalty": ["elasticnet"], "log__l1_ratio": [0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]
}


grid_log = GridSearchCV(log_pipe, param_grid_log, cv=10, scoring="accuracy")

grid_log.fit(X, y)
best_log = grid_log.best_estimator_


print("Best LogReg params:", grid_log.best_params_)
print("Best LogReg cv metric:", grid_log.best_score_)
```


```{python}
y_pred_log = best_log.predict(df_test)

inv_map = {
    0: "Republican",
    1: "Democrat",
    2: "Independent"
}
y_pred_labels = pd.Series(y_pred_log).map(inv_map)
pred_df = pd.DataFrame({
   'id_num': df_test['id_num'],
   "political_affiliation_predicted": y_pred_labels
})
pred_df.to_csv('RealFinalclass_fileupdated.csv', index=False)
```
